title: Computational Screening, ADME Study, and Evaluation of Benzothiazole Derivatives as Potential Anticancer Agents.
authors: Banwala, Sahil; Kush, Anuradha; Aggarwal, Sunaina; Sharma, Shivkant; Sindhu, Rakesh K
one_liner_zh: 该文为苯并噻唑衍生物的抗癌药物计算筛选与ADME研究，虽含分子对接但靶点为EGFR激酶而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Benzothiazole derivatives have garnered considerable interest in medicinal chemistry due to their diverse biological activities, including anticancer potential. The synthesis of 2-substituted benzothiazoles is traditionally achieved via two main approaches: (1) condensation of 2-aminothiophenols with aldehydes or carboxylic acid derivatives under highly acidic conditions, and (2) cyclization of thiobenzanilides. In this study, approximately 65 benzothiazole analogs were evaluated for anticancer potential using in silico tools and ADME profiling. MATERIALS AND METHODS: ADME properties were predicted using SwissADME, while molecular docking studies were performed using Molegro Virtual Docker 6.0. Gefitinib and Erlotinib were used as reference drugs for both pharmacokinetic and in silico comparisons. Biological activity predictions were conducted using the PASS online web server. RESULTS: Docking scores for the analogs ranged from -134.60 to -114.36, with several compounds outperforming standard drugs Gefitinib (-122.87) and Erlotinib (-119.22). Compounds 12, 17, 27, 43, and 49 exhibited five hydrogen bond interactions, whereas compound 45 showed a maximum of six, exceeding the interactions observed for the standard drugs. Most compounds had molecular weights below 500 and favorable Log P values (e.g., compounds 4: 2.34, 5: 2.85, 7: 2.56, 10: 2.76, 17: 2.78, 19: 2.51, 26: 2.09, 30: 1.20, 40: 1.78, 45: 1.76, 56: 1.75), lower than the reference drugs (3.92, 3.20). Selected compounds also displayed improved topological polar surface area (TPSA) values (e.g., 5: 80.05 A(2), 11: 79.46 A(2), 13: 71.83 A(2), 15: 87.74 A(2), 23: 68.82 A(2), 32: 61.36 A(2), 36: 45.53 A(2), 52: 41.13 A(2)) compared to standard drugs (68.74 A(2), 74.73 A(2)). Targeting EGFR using PASS predictions, compounds 32, 33, 35, 39, 46, and 48 exhibited activities similar to Gefitinib and Erlotinib. DISCUSSION: Docking and ADME analyses indicated that several benzothiazole analogs outperformed standard drugs in binding affinity and pharmacokinetic profiles. EGFR, a transmembrane receptor tyrosine kinase, plays a central role in cell proliferation, survival, angiogenesis, and migration. Most compounds demonstrated good gastrointestinal absorption, suggesting favorable oral bioavailability according to Lipinski, Ghose, Veber, Egan, and Muegge rules. PASS predictions indicated potential anticancer activities, including inhibition of transcription factor STAT3, DNAdirected RNA polymerase, Mcl-1, proto-oncogene tyrosine-protein kinase Fgr, and EGFR, with potential antineoplastic effects across multiple cancer types, including solid tumors, lung, gastric, lymphoma, sarcoma, breast, and pancreatic cancers. CONCLUSION: Compounds 12, 17, 27, 43, 45, and 49 demonstrated strong binding affinities and superior pharmacokinetic profiles compared to Gefitinib and Erlotinib. Overall, benzothiazole derivatives represent a promising scaffold for the design of EGFR inhibitors, potentially contributing to targeted anticancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 引言：苯并噻唑衍生物因其多样的生物活性，包括抗癌潜力，在药物化学领域引起了广泛关注。2-取代苯并噻唑的合成传统上通过两种主要方法实现：（1）在强酸性条件下，2-氨基苯硫酚与醛或羧酸衍生物缩合；（2）硫代苯甲酰苯胺的环化。本研究利用计算机模拟工具和ADME分析，评估了约65种苯并噻唑类似物的抗癌潜力。材料与方法：使用SwissADME预测ADME性质，分子对接研究采用Molegro Virtual Docker 6.0进行。吉非替尼（Gefitinib）和厄洛替尼（Erlotinib）作为药代动力学和计算机模拟比较的参考药物。生物活性预测通过PASS在线服务器进行。结果：类似物的对接得分范围为-134.60至-114.36，其中若干化合物优于标准药物吉非替尼（-122.87）和厄洛替尼（-119.22）。化合物12、17、27、43和49表现出五个氢键相互作用，而化合物45显示出最多六个，超过了标准药物观察到的相互作用。大多数化合物的分子量低于500，且具有有利的Log P值（例如，化合物4：2.34，5：2.85，7：2.56，10：2.76，17：2.78，19：2.51，26：2.09，30：1.20，40：1.78，45：1.76，56：1.75），低于参考药物（3.92，3.20）。所选化合物还显示出改善的拓扑极性表面积（TPSA）值（例如，5：80.05 A(2)，11：79.46 A(2)，13：71.83 A(2)，15：87.74 A(2)，23：68.82 A(2)，32：61.36 A(2)，36：45.53 A(2)，52：41.13 A(2)），与标准药物（68.74 A(2)，74.73 A(2)）相比。使用PASS预测靶向EGFR，化合物32、33、35、39、46和48表现出与吉非替尼和厄洛替尼相似的活性。讨论：对接和ADME分析表明，若干苯并噻唑类似物在结合亲和力和药代动力学特征方面优于标准药物。EGFR是一种跨膜受体酪氨酸激酶，在细胞增殖、存活、血管生成和迁移中发挥核心作用。大多数化合物表现出良好的胃肠道吸收，根据Lipinski、Ghose、Veber、Egan和Muegge规则，提示有利的口服生物利用度。PASS预测表明具有潜在抗癌活性，包括抑制转录因子STAT3、DNA指导的RNA聚合酶、Mcl-1、原癌基因酪氨酸蛋白激酶Fgr和EGFR，并在多种癌症类型中具有潜在抗肿瘤作用，包括实体瘤、肺癌、胃癌、淋巴瘤、肉瘤、乳腺癌和胰腺癌。结论：化合物12、17、27、43、45和49表现出强结合亲和力和优于吉非替尼及厄洛替尼的药代动力学特征。总体而言，苯并噻唑衍生物代表了设计EGFR抑制剂的有前景骨架，可能有助于靶向抗癌治疗。
